harness: DTap SDK / harness (internal main, not versioned in logs) with four agent frameworks: OpenAI Agents SDK (openaisdk), Claude Agent SDK (paper: "Claude Code" / "Claude Code SDK"; path claudesdk), Google ADK (googleadk), OpenClaw (openclaw; two OpenClaw log variants: 11,413 with metadata.mcp_tools, 5,765 with trace_id). No SDK/runtime version recorded (census sources/dtap.md §8). Attack generation by DTap-Red with GPT-5.1 surrogate in OpenAI Agents SDK, max 10 iterations (paper Sec. 6). Judges: paper Sec. 4.2/A.3 says deterministic rule-based verifiable judges and that LLM-based judges are avoided; the released judge results contain LLM-judge metadata (llm_judge/llm_model keyset on 458 files; gpt_model/gpt_score medical keysets on about 1,734; census c04). 458 judge results re-judged 2026-04-26 (patch h5_rejudge_20260426). Known judge bugs of the public harness: issues #14, #21, #23, #24 (see repo).

expected_counts: Part head: tree 133,851 files; trajectory-bearing JSON 67,808 (64,110 timestamp-named + 3,590 trajectory.json + 99 <TS>_N + 8 (1) copies + 1 partial) [tools/readme_corpora.toml count 67808; census c01e]; parseable 67,806 raw (+2 via LFS objects); synthetic 20 (not executions); red-teaming logs 8 and screenshot PNG pointers 122 (excluded); judge_result.json 65,902 (+8 copies), judge-only directories 22; task configs 6,682 (6,681 parse). Executions (derived, to be confirmed at L1/L2): 67,808 - 20 synthetic - 8 (1) copies = 67,780 trajectory executions, minus any byte-identical _N/plain pairs (>= 1 seen in the 500 sample), plus <= 22 outcome-only judge-only units (byte-identical judges collapse). Steps 1,609,274 (agent 834,985, tool 716,489, user 57,800). Paper: 6,682 tasks (2,806 benign, 1,878 direct, 1,998 indirect); runs per task not stated.
expected_arms: Facets framework x model x split x domain (14 domains; risk category below). 10 framework/model pairs x splits: 8 pairs with benign/direct/indirect/direct_prompt/direct_no_attack, openaisdk/gpt-5.1 without direct_no_attack, openclaw/gpt-5.4 (600/600/600/400) without direct_no_attack = 48 pair x split strata. direct_prompt only finance/legal/windows (gpt-5.1 and openclaw gpt-5.4: finance/legal); direct_no_attack only medical. Paper main tables: 8 rows of which 2 (OpenClaw GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Pro) are absent from the data; data has 3 pairs not in the main tables (claudesdk opus, openclaw opus: appendix only; openclaw gpt-5.4: finance/legal appendix only) and gpt-5.1 attack runs with no ASR table.

discrepancy_leads: Paper Table 3-5 rows OpenClaw GPT-5.5 and OpenClaw DeepSeek-V4-Pro have no runs in the release; the release instead has openclaw/claude-opus-4-6 and openclaw/gpt-5.4 (appendix rows only) and claudesdk/claude-opus-4-6 (appendix only). The HF card says "full collection".

Paper Overall = unweighted mean of 14 domain columns (verified for all 25 rows of Tables 3-4 to within 0.06 pp [corrected from 0.05: 24 rows within 0.05, Claude Code Sonnet-4.5 direct 26.84 vs 26.9]); domain values are means over risk categories. Census micro rates over judge files run 0.1-6.2 pp above the paper ASR (e.g. gpt-oss-120b direct 52.7 vs 46.5; gpt-5.2 direct 61.7 vs 58.8) and -5.4..+4.1 pp off BSR (gpt-5.1 73.3 vs 78.7). Per-domain comparison needed.

direct_prompt (no red-teaming) census ASR exceeds the paper baseline tables for 8 of 9 pairs with a paper row when weighted by finance 200 / legal 200 / windows 100: e.g. openclaw opus 41/500 vs about 19 expected, claudesdk sonnet 31 vs about 13; only openclaw gpt-5.4 matches exactly (10/400 = 2.5% vs finance 0.0, legal 5.0). Paper Table 64 has finance 0.0% for every pair except Gemini 2.5%.

Windows direct_prompt: Table 50 rates move in 5-point steps (20 tasks per category, 6 categories, about 120 per pair) but the data hold 100 windows direct_prompt runs per pair, 320 of them with no configuration.

Released judge directories per pair are 1,836 direct and 1,986 indirect versus 1,878 and 1,998 tasks in the paper (42 and 12 fewer); 93 configurations are referenced by no run (windows direct 80, windows indirect 7, macos 3, workflow 3).

Paper says the judges are deterministic rule-based checkers and LLM-based judges are avoided (Sec. 4.2, A.3), but judge metadata carry LLM-judge keys (llm_judge/llm_model on 458 files, gpt_* on about 1,734 medical files), and 458 results were re-judged on 2026-04-26 with a rubric change.

Public-harness judge bugs may or may not affect the released judgements: customer-service attack judge no-op (#14), Delete-sensitive-files host check (#21), legal indirect self-matching judges on 12 named tasks (#23, open), os-filesystem indirect/52 wrong judge (#24, open).

Paper v1 is dated 2026-05-06, one day after the last run (2026-05-05T03:53:41Z); the 20 synthetic "repaired" trajectories are dated 2026-05-12 and the macOS/Windows logs were uploaded 2026-07-01: the release was assembled after the paper and contains post-hoc artefacts (synthetic, re-judged).

Medical direct_no_attack census ASR equals paper Table 82 to 0.1 pp for 7 of 8 pairs (gpt-5.4 14.6 vs 15.1, consistent with 29 vs 30 tasks per category in the paper): a positive control for the judge-level tally.

Free-text model mentions (claude-sonnet-4-20250514 in 237 files, claude-sonnet-4-50 in 127) may indicate a different model version in some claudesdk runs, or may be task content; the logs carry no structured model id.

Home-directory strings, including one account name matching a paper author, appear in tool content of the 500-run sample (dtap-sample-check.md U14: 46 AER and 14 PROV hits for that name); the dtap profile has no redaction table and D-182 leaves model/benchmark content unredacted.

gpt-5.1 has 1,209 direct, 1,232 indirect and 408 direct_prompt runs but no ASR row anywhere in the paper (it was the DTap-Red surrogate); Table 81 says medical indirect tasks were selected from tasks GPT-5.1 solved.
